correctness.rationale: A fully specified deterministic 15-bit exhaustive cycle enumerator, with a second Kneser-model check, finds exactly 20 longest nonagons. Their downward closure has 6,320 faces. A 3,110-pair discrete-Morse matching has exactly one critical zero-cell and 99 critical four-cells. The complete directed Hasse graph of 32,775 incidences topologically sorts with all 6,320 vertices, proving acyclicity. The corresponding CW complex has only a point and 99 four-cells, whose maps are necessarily constant, establishing the integral sphere-wedge homotopy type. An independent mod-two boundary computation agrees; scripts and actual successful replay output are supplied.

evidence: The previously known Hamiltonian-path containment complex has maximal faces of size nine that are spanning simple paths; a nine-cycle is not a nine-edge Hamiltonian path.
The 2-matching complex admits *all* degree-at-most-two edge subsets including disconnected cycle/path unions, whereas this complex requires extension to one longest connected simple cycle.
The ordinary matching, graph Morse, and cut complexes use other face relations and neither a retraction nor an implication on homotopy follows from containment alone.
broader_coverage.reasoning: Known classifications of broader or related complexes do not automatically classify this down-set. The exact edge-set containment conditions were compared, rather than titles or coincident sphere dimensions.

originality.rationale: The new claim is the homotopy type of the downward closure of Petersen nine-cycle edge sets, not cycle enumeration or the ordinary Hamiltonian-path/matching/3-cut/Morse complexes. Exact face conditions and their implications were compared. The published cycle count does not determine the nerve/intersections or homotopy. Broad primary and indexed-search checks revealed no homotopy determination, although unindexed work and the inaccessible later monograph chapter remain residual risks.

value.rationale: Longest-cycle extension is a canonical property of the smallest hypohamiltonian graph. The pure dimension-eight nonagon containment complex has a non-obvious full integral homotopy type of 99 four-spheres. A cycle count alone does not determine overlap topology or sphere-wedge homotopy. The exact classification, nonflag minimal obstruction profile, and fully reproducible acyclic-Morse certificate are independently motivated and useful as a finite topological benchmark, without claiming a general graph-family theorem.
